description:
Enables or disables AI-assisted change tracking in the document.
Only the change tracking of the current user is turned on: the document setting is not changed. Calls can be
nested: the previous state is restored when every call with isTrack set to true is matched by a call with isTrack
set to false. While it is enabled, {@link ApiDocument#SetTrackRevisions} does nothing and returns false.

params.description: Specifies whether the change tracking mode is set or not.
params.name: isTrack

params.description: The AI assistant name used as the author of the tracked changes. Required when isTrack is true; if it is not a non-empty string, "Anonymous" is used. Not used when isTrack is false. Ignored by nested calls.
params.name: assistantName

returns.description: Returns false if isTrack is false and AI-assisted change tracking is not enabled.
